description: Create a scheduled task for one of the user's agents. Supported schedule types: once (run_at ISO local time + timezone), interval (interval_minutes 5-1440), hourly, daily (time HH:MM + timezone), weekly (time + timezone + days_of_week 0=Sunday..6), cron (5-field expression + timezone), manual (only runs on demand). Returns the normalized schedule and the computed next_run_at so you can read the fire time back to the user in their timezone. For 'tell me when a new X comes in' (a lead, an order, a signup, any record of an app entity) do not poll with a plain interval: set watch, and the task costs nothing until a new record arrives.

activate.description: Start the schedule immediately (true) or save as draft (false)

agent_id.description: The agent id (from create_agent or list_agents)

instructions.description: What the agent should do on each run, written as instructions to the agent

max_runs.description: Optional cap on total runs (0 = unlimited)

watch.description: Run the task only when a record is new, e.g. {"provider":"app_records","app_id":"<app id>","entity":"Lead"} with an interval schedule. The platform checks each interval with no model call and no credits, and starts the agent only when a record arrived, with those records in hand. Works for any entity of the user's own apps. Optional: where (exact field values such as {"status":"new"}), include_existing (also act on the records already there).

name: schedule_agent_task
title: Schedule Agent Task
